gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patient with a localized disease for which no curative therapy is available ... are allowed (example: GBM or sarcoma with local relapse after surgery, chemo-radiation)

gbm_population_flag.reason: GBM is named only as an example in an inclusion criterion of a general solid-tumour trial.

candidate_evidence.quote: MVX-ONCO-2 is a patient-specific, cell-based, active immunotherapy where the participant's immune response to their own tumor cells is stimulated and/or increased.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: documented tumor progression after at least one line of systemic therapy and for which no further standard therapies are available

role_evidence.quote: Implantation of 2 capsules containing MVX-2 cells and 1 injection of 4 × 10^6 lethally irradiated autologous tumor cells

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous tumour-cell vaccine with GM-CSF-secreting allogeneic cells (cell-based cancer vaccine; excluded type)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: active immunotherapy stimulating the participant's immune response to their own tumor cells

coder_notes: Basket phase 1 of a patient-specific cell-based cancer vaccine; no pharmacological candidate. GBM mentioned only as an example of an eligible localized disease.
